newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav Jan wages fall 12.0 pct to 618 dinars.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav Jan wages fall 12.0 pct to 618 dinars.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV AVERAGE NET WAGES JAN 97 DEC 96 JAN 96

NOTE - The Federal Statistics Office has changed the method for calculating average monthly wages to include all employed in a given month, regardless of whether they all received wages earned in that month. (Wages are sometimes paid with several months delay).
Last month, the office said December wages were 881 dinars ($162), up 11.9 percent on November.
Data do not include private sector.
-- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305 ($ = 5.423 Yugoslav Dinars)
